# apple_app_availability (Resource)

Sets up where an app is sold. An app isn't available anywhere until it has an availability; creating this resource creates one with every territory unavailable, or manages the existing one. Make the app available in a territory with `apple_app_territory_availability`. App Store Connect can't delete an availability, so destroying the resource leaves it. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_availability" "example" {
  app_id                       = data.apple_app.example.id
  available_in_new_territories = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `available_in_new_territories` (Boolean) Whether the app becomes available in territories the App Store adds later.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the availability.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_availability.example
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_availability.example 1234567890
```
